text_post: They both brought a kid into the world, and if they didn't want that, they should have had protected sex. That said, he is doing what he feels he should, because he wants to be a good father. I imagine if he were to think of his situation as being used by the mother, he might take her to court, and get a more designated arrangement put into place, which sadly would lessen his time with his child. So, while it does seem exploitative, he may be doing this because he is a selfless person who puts his kid first. I'm not sure why he is there for her beyond that, but...only he can put a stop to that. He doesn't need to sit and be a shoulder to cry on, that is something he has the power to stop. He has a choice in that much of it, but as far as the kid goes...there are some very selfless people in the world, and he might just be one of them. What's sad about the story from the little we know, is that it might be safe to assume that he was selfless in the relationship with her, as he is to his kid...and she took advantage of that. Many women, unfortunately, look at selflessness as weakness. It's not just women, either. As a culture, many people look at selfless people as weak, and as opportunities to walk on. If he were to become like her, a self absorbed type who uses women, what will he gain? If he becomes like her, he will lose. She is losing actually, she just doesn't know it, yet. But, she will. I respect him for doing what he thinks is best, he's not a ''hero,'' he is just merely following his conscience. Probably why she left this good guy, is he is too good for her.
